rules: Persist queued product job before acquiring all-owner quiescence. Exempt only exact own pre-effect job, as existing recovery does.
Every mutating owner port requires distinct advertised reset support and exact held-maintenance context; hide/disposal markers are not authorization.

Reset one owner atomically where possible; persist original per-owner child commands. Partial/unknown multi-owner outcomes stay fenced and inspectable; no automatic roll-forward, compensating reset or replay.
Prepared review is bounded/paged; expiry and all owner revisions rechecked under holds. Unknown fields/roots block the part.
Do not expose private values in schema/topic/preview/receipt. Retained app credentials stay private and unencrypted with explicit disclosure.
After success release only from exact job/owner receipts and actual lease disposition. No process starts or prompt resume.
Typed RESET remains a fresh UI confirmation bound to exact review, separate from trusted authorization; never persist consent as a reusable future approval.
